name: Roh Young-wan
bio: Roh Young-wan is a South Korean actor, producer, inversor and filmmaker.

credits.title: Halo
credits.overview: Min-joon, 27, who bears the burden of his broken family, delivers packages every day, dreaming of being a film director. A soothsayer lights a flame within him. Daily repetition and slippage create unique rhythms.

credits.title: Spirits' Homecoming, Unfinished Story
credits.overview: "Spirits' Homecoming, Unfinished Story" is part dramatization and part documentary. The film contains scenes from the movie “Spirits’ Homecoming” and testimonials by comfort women who were enslaved by the Japanese Imperial Army during World War II.

credits.title: Spirits' Homecoming
credits.overview: After the Japanese kidnap two Korean teenagers and take them to a comfort station to join other girls who are serving as sex slaves, only one of them survives. Decades later, the elderly woman tries to reunite with her friend's spirit.
